stem: During a routine crop walk, several plants show lower-leaf discoloration. Which note is the best technician observation?
choices: The plants definitely have a magnesium deficiency
Lower leaves on 6 of 20 plants in Zone B show interveinal yellowing; photos and room readings attached
The cultivar is weak and should be removed
rationale: Technician observations should record specific visible evidence, location and useful context without claiming a cause that has not been established.
